title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: The Witcher 3 is an open-world RPG following Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter for hire. Features over 100 hours of gameplay, morally complex choices, and two award-winning expansions.

title: Minecraft
description: Minecraft is a sandbox game where players explore procedurally generated worlds, gather resources, craft tools, and build structures. It features survival and creative modes.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II
description: Modern Warfare II features an immersive single-player campaign, classic multiplayer modes, and the return of Special Ops. Built on an all-new engine with improved graphics and gameplay.

title: Fortnite
description: Fortnite is a free-to-play battle royale game where 100 players fight to be the last one standing. Features building mechanics, seasonal content updates, and crossover events.

title: Spider-Man: Miles Morales
description: Follow Miles Morales as he masters his new powers as the new Spider-Man while protecting Brooklyn from a war between a corrupt energy corporation and the Tinkerer's army.

title: Starfield
description: Starfield is Bethesda's first new universe in over 25 years. Set in the year 2330, players explore the galaxy as a member of Constellation, uncovering the mysteries of the universe.

title: Super Mario Odyssey
description: Join Mario and his new ally Cappy on a massive, globe-trotting 3D adventure. Use Cappy to capture and control enemies, navigate unique kingdoms, and rescue Princess Peach from Bowser.

title: Apex Legends
description: Apex Legends is a free-to-play battle royale game set in the Titanfall universe. Features unique Legends with special abilities, squad-based gameplay, and fast-paced combat.

title: Hogwarts Legacy
description: An immersive open-world action RPG set in the 1800s wizarding world. Students attend Hogwarts, learn spells, brew potions, and uncover a hidden truth about the wizarding world.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in Baldur's Gate 3. A story-rich RPG based on D&D 5th Edition rules, featuring deep character customization and co-op multiplayer.
